title: News Tells You What Happened. Drawing Shows You How It Felt | George Butler | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】新聞告訴你發生了什麼事。繪畫向您展示了它的感受 |喬治·巴特勒 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: A couple of years ago, I stood on the streets in eastern Ukraine,
cues.en: A couple of years ago, I stood on the streets in eastern Ukraine,
cues.zh: 幾年前，我站在烏克蘭東部的街道上，

cues.text: in Kramatorsk, in the aftermath of a Russian cruise missile strike
cues.en: in Kramatorsk, in the aftermath of a Russian cruise missile strike
cues.zh: 俄羅斯巡航飛彈襲擊後的克拉馬託爾斯克

cues.text: on a residential apartment building.
cues.en: on a residential apartment building.
cues.zh: 在一棟住宅公寓樓上。

cues.text: I remember the front of the building was blown off.
cues.en: I remember the front of the building was blown off.
cues.zh: 我記得大樓的正面被炸毀了。

cues.text: You could see a living room and a kitchen inside, belongings burnt, scattered on the floor, mixed in with the rubble.
cues.en: You could see a living room and a kitchen inside, belongings burnt, scattered on the floor, mixed in with the rubble.
cues.zh: 你可以看到裡面有一個客廳和一個廚房，財產被燒毀，散落在地板上，與瓦礫混在一起。

cues.text: There were some weapons inspectors on one side, an excavator in the middle,
cues.en: There were some weapons inspectors on one side, an excavator in the middle,
cues.zh: 一邊有一些武器檢查員，中間有一臺挖土機，

cues.text: and of course, in amongst it all, the journalists were there, trying to interview those involved.
cues.en: and of course, in amongst it all, the journalists were there, trying to interview those involved.
cues.zh: 當然，在這一切之中，記者也在場，試圖採訪那些相關人員。

cues.text: One lady in particular had soot on her face.
cues.en: One lady in particular had soot on her face.
cues.zh: 尤其是一位女士，她的臉上沾滿了煙灰。

cues.text: It was very moving to watch.
cues.en: It was very moving to watch.
cues.zh: 觀看起來非常感人。

cues.text: She gathered her belongings from the rubble, and she put them on the floor,
cues.en: She gathered her belongings from the rubble, and she put them on the floor,
cues.zh: 她從廢墟中撿起自己的物品，把它們放在地板上，

cues.text: and she sat on them for safekeeping.
cues.en: and she sat on them for safekeeping.
cues.zh: 她坐在上面以妥善保管。

cues.text: These are the sorts of scenes that are broadcast around the world every night.
cues.en: These are the sorts of scenes that are broadcast around the world every night.
cues.zh: 這些場景每晚都會在世界各地播出。

cues.text: And I sat and drew this image -- that’s her in the black at the front.
cues.en: And I sat and drew this image -- that’s her in the black at the front.
cues.zh: 我坐下來畫了這張圖——前面是她穿黑衣服的樣子。

cues.text: I found them to be so moving.
cues.en: I found them to be so moving.
cues.zh: 我發現他們是如此感人。

cues.text: And let me tell you -- the destruction is truly captivating.
cues.en: And let me tell you -- the destruction is truly captivating.
cues.zh: 讓我告訴你——這種破壞確實令人著迷。

cues.text: But around the back of the same building, I found a library of books had been blasted into a rose garden,
cues.en: But around the back of the same building, I found a library of books had been blasted into a rose garden,
cues.zh: 但在同一棟大樓的後面，我發現一個藏書的圖書館被炸成了玫瑰園，

cues.text: and in amongst the thorns and the roses stood Petro, age 70.
cues.en: and in amongst the thorns and the roses stood Petro, age 70.
cues.zh: 70歲的佩特羅就站在荊棘和玫瑰之中。

cues.text: On his morning walk, he couldn't go any further.
cues.en: On his morning walk, he couldn't go any further.
cues.zh: 早上散步時，他無法再走下去了。

cues.text: He felt it was his duty to stop, pick up the books, stack them in neat little piles.
cues.en: He felt it was his duty to stop, pick up the books, stack them in neat little piles.
cues.zh: 他覺得自己有責任停下來，拿起書，把它們整齊地堆成小堆。

cues.text: And as I drew him, he challenged me, and he said "I was brought up
cues.en: And as I drew him, he challenged me, and he said "I was brought up
cues.zh: 當我畫他時，他向我挑戰，他說「我是在

cues.text: that if I see a loaf of bread on the floor, I'll pick it up.
cues.en: that if I see a loaf of bread on the floor, I'll pick it up.
cues.zh: 如果我看到地板上有一條麵包，我會把它撿起來。

cues.text: It's the same with books.
cues.en: It's the same with books.
cues.zh: 書籍也是如此。

cues.text: They are food for the soul." I've drawn mass graves in Ukraine,
cues.en: They are food for the soul." I've drawn mass graves in Ukraine,
cues.zh: 它們是靈魂的食糧。 「我在烏克蘭畫了萬人坑

cues.text: a cesarean in Afghanistan and the war in Syria.
cues.en: a cesarean in Afghanistan and the war in Syria.
cues.zh: 阿富汗的剖腹產和敘利亞的戰爭。

cues.text: And over two decades, I’ve had one realization over and over,
cues.en: And over two decades, I’ve had one realization over and over,
cues.zh: 二十年來，我一遍又一遍地意識到一個事實，

cues.text: that there are many truths to war.
cues.en: that there are many truths to war.
cues.zh: 戰爭有很多真相。

cues.text: But on that morning in Kramatorsk, in Ukraine, it was so stark.
cues.en: But on that morning in Kramatorsk, in Ukraine, it was so stark.
cues.zh: 但在烏克蘭克拉馬託爾斯克的那天早上，情況是如此嚴峻。

cues.text: It was Petro that captured my heart, this gentle soul standing amidst atrocity.
cues.en: It was Petro that captured my heart, this gentle soul standing amidst atrocity.
cues.zh: 是佩特羅擄獲了我的心，這個溫柔的靈魂站在暴行中。

cues.text: This is what I do.
cues.en: This is what I do.
cues.zh: 這就是我所做的。

cues.text: I draw for magazines and newspapers, in ink, on location.
cues.en: I draw for magazines and newspapers, in ink, on location.
cues.zh: 我在現場用墨水為雜誌和報紙畫畫。

cues.text: And over weeks and weeks in Ukraine, it became my mission to be slow, to delve deeper.
cues.en: And over weeks and weeks in Ukraine, it became my mission to be slow, to delve deeper.
cues.zh: 在烏克蘭的幾周裡，我的使命是慢慢地、深入地研究。

cues.text: And I found that the news can tell us what happened,
cues.en: And I found that the news can tell us what happened,
cues.zh: 我發現新聞可以告訴我們發生了什麼，

cues.text: but the drawing can show us how it felt.
cues.en: but the drawing can show us how it felt.
cues.zh: 但圖畫可以向我們展示它的感受。

cues.text: In Kyiv, I met Madame Olga, aged 99.
cues.en: In Kyiv, I met Madame Olga, aged 99.
cues.zh: 在基輔，我遇到了 99 歲的奧爾加夫人。

cues.text: She was too old to get out of her bed when the air-raid sirens rang.
cues.en: She was too old to get out of her bed when the air-raid sirens rang.
cues.zh: 當空襲警報響起時，她已經太老了，無法起床。

cues.text: I remember she had a Bible tucked under her pillow.
cues.en: I remember she had a Bible tucked under her pillow.
cues.zh: 我記得她枕頭底下藏著一本《聖經》。

cues.text: She was very muddled, she was confusing Putin and Hitler, and she held the translator's hands about six inches from her face.
cues.en: She was very muddled, she was confusing Putin and Hitler, and she held the translator's hands about six inches from her face.
cues.zh: 她很糊塗，她把普丁和希特勒搞混了，她把翻譯的手握在離她臉大約六英寸的地方。

cues.text: And in this moment of wonderful clarity, she said,
cues.en: And in this moment of wonderful clarity, she said,
cues.zh: 在這無比清晰的時刻，她說：

cues.text: "If you be quiet, I will tell you the story from the beginning."
cues.en: "If you be quiet, I will tell you the story from the beginning."
cues.zh: “如果你安靜的話，我就從頭告訴你故事。”

cues.text: She was born in 1923.
cues.en: She was born in 1923.
cues.zh: 她出生於1923年。

cues.text: She was taken to a collective farm with her father.
cues.en: She was taken to a collective farm with her father.
cues.zh: 她和父親一起被帶到一個集體農場。

cues.text: She survived the Holodomor -- the great famine which killed four million Ukrainians.
cues.en: She survived the Holodomor -- the great famine which killed four million Ukrainians.
cues.zh: 她在大饑荒中存活下來，這場大饑荒導致四百萬烏克蘭人死亡。

cues.text: When World War II started, she worked as a slave for a Nazi family.
cues.en: When World War II started, she worked as a slave for a Nazi family.
cues.zh: 第二次世界大戰開始時，她為納粹家庭當奴隸。

cues.text: She recounted the story about one time they fed her worms.
cues.en: She recounted the story about one time they fed her worms.
cues.zh: 她講述了一次他們給她餵蟲子的故事。

cues.text: She ran away, on another occasion, to the police station, but the policeman returned her straight back to the house.
cues.en: She ran away, on another occasion, to the police station, but the policeman returned her straight back to the house.
cues.zh: 她還有一次逃到警察局，但警察直接把她送回了家。

cues.text: When the war ended, she began to walk home to Ukraine.
cues.en: When the war ended, she began to walk home to Ukraine.
cues.zh: 戰爭結束後，她開始步行返回烏克蘭。

cues.text: She met her husband on the way -- future husband, I should say.
cues.en: She met her husband on the way -- future husband, I should say.
cues.zh: 她在路上遇到了她的丈夫——我應該說是未來的丈夫。

cues.text: They got married.
cues.en: They got married.
cues.zh: 他們結婚了。

cues.text: She had four children.
cues.en: She had four children.
cues.zh: 她有四個孩子。

cues.text: She lived another 80 years.
cues.en: She lived another 80 years.
cues.zh: 她又活了80歲。

cues.text: If it hadn't been for the process of drawing, I wouldn’t have shared this moment with Olga,
cues.en: If it hadn't been for the process of drawing, I wouldn’t have shared this moment with Olga,
cues.zh: 如果沒有繪畫的過程，我不會和奧爾加分享這一刻，

cues.text: and I wouldn't be able to share it with you.
cues.en: and I wouldn't be able to share it with you.
cues.zh: 我無法與你分享。

cues.text: She died a couple of months after we met, peacefully, in her sleep, before her 100th birthday.
cues.en: She died a couple of months after we met, peacefully, in her sleep, before her 100th birthday.
cues.zh: 我們見面幾個月後，她在睡夢中平靜地去世了，當時她正值 100 歲生日。

cues.text: I believe the news is failing us.
cues.en: I believe the news is failing us.
cues.zh: 我相信這個訊息讓我們失望了。

cues.text: It promotes destruction before humanity.
cues.en: It promotes destruction before humanity.
cues.zh: 它促進人類面前的毀滅。

cues.text: It's polarizing and fatiguing.
cues.en: It's polarizing and fatiguing.
cues.zh: 這是兩極分化和疲勞的。

cues.text: It gives the illusion of certainty.
cues.en: It gives the illusion of certainty.
cues.zh: 它給人一種確定性的錯覺。

cues.text: You might feel helpless or hopeless.
cues.en: You might feel helpless or hopeless.
cues.zh: 您可能會感到無助或絕望。

cues.text: We'd certainly be forgiven for turning it off.
cues.en: We'd certainly be forgiven for turning it off.
cues.zh: 我們當然可以原諒將其關閉。

cues.text: My antidote is to wander the streets and stand on corners.
cues.en: My antidote is to wander the streets and stand on corners.
cues.zh: 我的解藥是在街上閒逛，站在街角。

cues.text: I work with local translators and fixers to interview the unsung and the understated.
cues.en: I work with local translators and fixers to interview the unsung and the understated.
cues.zh: 我與當地的翻譯和調解人合作，採訪那些默默無聞和低調的人。

cues.text: Like Oleg, 23-year-old mixed martial arts fighter and football fan from Ukraine.
cues.en: Like Oleg, 23-year-old mixed martial arts fighter and football fan from Ukraine.
cues.zh: 例如 Oleg，23 歲，來自烏克蘭的綜合格鬥選手和足球迷。

cues.text: He joined the military to fight the Russians with his football friends.
cues.en: He joined the military to fight the Russians with his football friends.
cues.zh: 他參軍是為了和他的足球朋友一起對抗俄羅斯人。

cues.text: But on this day, I drew him being served borscht
cues.en: But on this day, I drew him being served borscht
cues.zh: 但在這一天，我畫了他正在吃羅宋湯

cues.text: by his mother, Lisa, the English teacher from that town,
cues.en: by his mother, Lisa, the English teacher from that town,
cues.zh: 他的母親麗莎是那個鎮上的英文老師，

cues.text: and he posed for me with his Kalashnikov, but also, more unusually, with his guinea pig, Almond.
cues.en: and he posed for me with his Kalashnikov, but also, more unusually, with his guinea pig, Almond.
cues.zh: 他拿著他的卡拉什尼科夫衝鋒槍給我擺了個姿勢，但更不尋常的是，他還帶著他的豚鼠阿爾蒙德。

cues.text: And throughout the sitting, he whispered to Almond affectionately,
cues.en: And throughout the sitting, he whispered to Almond affectionately,
cues.zh: 在整個坐著的過程中，他親切地對阿爾蒙德耳語道：

cues.text: "You are a big pig." "You are a big pig."
cues.en: "You are a big pig." "You are a big pig."
cues.zh: “你真是一頭大豬。” “你真是一頭大豬。”

cues.text: It's people like Sergei that remind me that these stories are continuing
cues.en: It's people like Sergei that remind me that these stories are continuing
cues.zh: 是像謝爾蓋這樣的人提醒我這些故事還在繼續

cues.text: as I stand in front of you.
cues.en: as I stand in front of you.
cues.zh: 當我站在你面前時。

cues.text: Perhaps the most ordinary of them all.
cues.en: Perhaps the most ordinary of them all.
cues.zh: 也許是其中最普通的一個。

cues.text: An architect whose house fell on his head when it was hit by a Russian missile.
cues.en: An architect whose house fell on his head when it was hit by a Russian missile.
cues.zh: 一位建築師的房子被俄羅斯飛彈擊中，他的房子倒塌了。

cues.text: And I met him in the hospital, bandage wrapped around his head.
cues.en: And I met him in the hospital, bandage wrapped around his head.
cues.zh: 我在醫院遇見了他，他的頭上纏著繃帶。

cues.text: I asked if I could draw him and the nurse translated.
cues.en: I asked if I could draw him and the nurse translated.
cues.zh: 我問我可不可以畫他，護士翻譯了。

cues.text: And he looked at me down his nose and he grinned from ear to ear, and said,
cues.en: And he looked at me down his nose and he grinned from ear to ear, and said,
cues.zh: 他用鼻子看著我，笑得合不攏嘴，說：

cues.text: "Yes, but I will also draw you." And, very formally, a date was arranged for the next day,
cues.en: "Yes, but I will also draw you." And, very formally, a date was arranged for the next day,
cues.zh: 「是啊，不過我也會畫你。」並且非常正式地安排了第二天的約會，

cues.text: and I came back and we sat in one of the wardrooms.
cues.en: and I came back and we sat in one of the wardrooms.
cues.zh: 我回來後，我們坐在一間軍官室。

cues.text: The windows were still sellotaped up in case there was an explosion.
cues.en: The windows were still sellotaped up in case there was an explosion.
cues.zh: 窗戶還用膠帶封著，以防爆炸。

cues.text: And we sat and we drew each other.
cues.en: And we sat and we drew each other.
cues.zh: 我們坐下來互相畫畫。

cues.text: We didn't share any common language.
cues.en: We didn't share any common language.
cues.zh: 我們沒有任何共同語言。

cues.text: We were both shy about our drawings.
cues.en: We were both shy about our drawings.
cues.zh: 我們都對自己的畫感到害羞。

cues.text: Like all good artists, he blamed his tools for the quality of his picture.
cues.en: Like all good artists, he blamed his tools for the quality of his picture.
cues.zh: 像所有優秀的藝術家一樣，他將畫作的品質歸咎於他的工具。

cues.text: And he'd probably be secretly proud to know that I'm showing you this.
cues.en: And he'd probably be secretly proud to know that I'm showing you this.
cues.zh: 如果他知道我正在向你展示這個，他可能會暗自自豪。

cues.text: Sergei, this is your story.
cues.en: Sergei, this is your story.
cues.zh: 謝爾蓋，這是你的故事。

cues.text: Of course, these are only four stories from Ukraine.
cues.en: Of course, these are only four stories from Ukraine.
cues.zh: 當然，這只是烏克蘭的四個故事。

cues.text: But over the years, in Syria and Tajikistan, Gaza and Iraq,
cues.en: But over the years, in Syria and Tajikistan, Gaza and Iraq,
cues.zh: 但多年來，在敘利亞和塔吉克、加薩和伊拉克，

cues.text: I have met and drawn hundreds of other people.
cues.en: I have met and drawn hundreds of other people.
cues.zh: 我見過並畫過數百人。

cues.text: But why, in the age of immediate news, do you need to know about Almond, the guinea pig,
cues.en: But why, in the age of immediate news, do you need to know about Almond, the guinea pig,
cues.zh: 但是，為什麼在新聞即時的時代，你需要了解小白鼠杏仁，

cues.text: or Sergei the architect or Olga, the great-great-grandmother?
cues.en: or Sergei the architect or Olga, the great-great-grandmother?
cues.zh: 或建築師謝爾蓋或曾曾祖母奧爾加？

cues.text: Or Hamdo, Lisa, Dimitri?
cues.en: Or Hamdo, Lisa, Dimitri?
cues.zh: 或是哈姆多、麗莎、迪米特里？

cues.text: Well perhaps it’s obvious: I believe they could so easily have been one of us.
cues.en: Well perhaps it’s obvious: I believe they could so easily have been one of us.
cues.zh: 好吧，也許這是顯而易見的：我相信他們很容易成為我們中的一員。

cues.text: They are the true consequences of war.
cues.en: They are the true consequences of war.
cues.zh: 它們是戰爭的真正後果。

cues.text: And I tell you about them, I share them with you tonight because they are ordinary people who had terror poured on their lives
cues.en: And I tell you about them, I share them with you tonight because they are ordinary people who had terror poured on their lives
cues.zh: 我告訴你他們的事，今晚我與你分享，因為他們是普通人，他們的生活充滿了恐懼

cues.text: and resisted it with their hearts.
cues.en: and resisted it with their hearts.
cues.zh: 並用內心去反抗。

cues.text: I would like to finish with a confession.
cues.en: I would like to finish with a confession.
cues.zh: 我想以懺悔結束。

cues.text: More of an admission, if you like, but a difficult one for artists, I think, to admit.
cues.en: More of an admission, if you like, but a difficult one for artists, I think, to admit.
cues.zh: 如果你願意的話，更多的是一種承認，但我認為，對於藝術家來說，承認這一點很難。

cues.text: As it turns out, it isn't really about the painting at all.
cues.en: As it turns out, it isn't really about the painting at all.
cues.zh: 事實證明，這根本與繪畫無關。

cues.text: That's just an excuse to sit a little longer, to give time.
cues.en: That's just an excuse to sit a little longer, to give time.
cues.zh: 這只是多坐一會兒、給時間的藉口。

cues.text: We've heard about listening accurately today.
cues.en: We've heard about listening accurately today.
cues.zh: 今天我們聽過準確聆聽。

cues.text: This is about observing, seeing properly.
cues.en: This is about observing, seeing properly.
cues.zh: 這是關於觀察、正確地看待。

cues.text: Drawing is the only way I know how to do that.
cues.en: Drawing is the only way I know how to do that.
cues.zh: 繪畫是我知道如何做到這一點的唯一方法。

cues.text: But today, I invite you -- more than that actually, if I'm allowed --
cues.en: But today, I invite you -- more than that actually, if I'm allowed --
cues.zh: 但今天，我邀請你——實際上，如果允許的話——

cues.text: I urge you to witness these stories and not consume them.
cues.en: I urge you to witness these stories and not consume them.
cues.zh: 我敦促您見證這些故事，而不是消費它們。

cues.text: To be deliberately slow and to cherish human connection.
cues.en: To be deliberately slow and to cherish human connection.
cues.zh: 刻意放慢腳步，珍惜人與人之間的連結。

cues.text: Thank you for listening.
cues.en: Thank you for listening.
cues.zh: 感謝您的聆聽。
